definitions.short: a divan (as enclosing the room); abstractly (adverbial) around
definitions.usage: that compass about, (place) round about, at table.
definitions.full: H4524. mesab or mesibbim or mesibboth מֵסַב noun [masculine] that which surrounds, or is round ; — 1. a. plural surrounding places , ׳יְרוּשׁ מְסִבֵּי 2Kin 23:5 places round about Jerusalem . b. as adverb מֵסַב round about 1Kin 6:29 ; feminine plural מְסִבּוֺת on all sides, in all directions , Job 37:12 (of cloud Di < of lightning Bu Du). 2 suffix מְסִבּוֺ Song 1:12 dubious: round table Ew De; cushion, divan Bae Kau; compare on all these Bu. — מְסִבָּ֑י Psa 140:10 see סבב Hiph`il
definitions.rootNote: plural masculine מְסִבִּים ; or feminine מְסִבּוֹת ; from 5437 ;
